limits: Exact native bossGladiator / bootsBossGladiator / renderer 121661 source assignment only; visible body, hair, armor and other companion surfaces do not credit their sibling topology groups or renderer sources.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 11 HP to 1 HP; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture at 1 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Nineteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 311 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The death capture retained 90 of 120 requested frames, then ended at a verified controller-unresolved boundary after a pinned native Death trigger; full-duration death and later corpse visibility are not claimed.
Structured capture records m_DoRagdoll true and 11 active rigid bodies becoming nonkinematic from retained death frame 28; the claim is limited to the sampled visible ragdoll prefix.

Native body, hair, armor, helmet, shield, weapon, combat UI, effects, foreground hero, depth blur, and camera motion limit fine surface inspection; no sampled tearing, renderer loss, viewport-edge clipping, floor fall-through, or footwear separation was observed.
Other proficiencies, DeathLight, portrait, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
